meta.name: programmatic-seo
meta.description: Builds large sets of search-targeted pages from a template and a dataset — the location, comparison, integration, and use-case pages that capture long-tail demand at scale. Use this when there is a repeating query pattern with real volume, when a dataset could answer many similar searches, or to judge whether a programmatic approach is viable before building it.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 批量生成搜索友好的网页
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手握数据,想批量做出能获取搜索流量的网页
copy.tagline_en: Turn data into SEO-friendly pages at scale
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have data and want to generate many pages that rank in search

howto.what: Claude 会先评估你的选题是否适合程序化 SEO（需同时满足四点），再帮你从模板+数据集批量生成搜索页面，并落实数据下限、内部链接、分批上线等规则，还会提醒维护和删除无效页面。
howto.when: 当你说要为一类重复搜索模式（如地点、对比等）批量建页面，或有数据集想回答大量相似查询，或想先判断程序化方法是否可行时，这个技能会启用。

say.text: 我想给 500 个城市各做一个'最佳餐厅'页，先帮我判断值不值得做。
say.note: 先走资格评估，避免白做。

say.text: 用这个模板和 CSV 数据，给每个产品生成对比页，数据缺失的跳过。
say.note: 确保每页有实质内容，不生成空页。

say.text: 先手工做一个示例页给我看，再决定模板怎么写。
say.note: 模板前先验证单页价值。

howto.what_en: Claude will first assess whether your plan qualifies for programmatic SEO (all four conditions must hold), then help you generate search-targeted pages in bulk from a template plus a dataset, enforcing a data threshold, internal linking, batch rollout, and maintenance/pruning rules.
howto.when_en: This activates when you describe a repeating query pattern with real volume, have a dataset that could answer many similar searches, or want to judge whether a programmatic approach is viable before building.

say_en.text: I want a 'best restaurant' page for 500 cities; first tell me if it's worth doing.
say_en.note: Runs qualification to avoid wasted effort.

say_en.text: Hand-craft the best single example page first, then decide the template.
